name: decodo_scrape
description: Scrape any web page through Decodo (formerly Smartproxy) rotating proxies and return its content. Handles anti-bot pages; use render_js:true for JavaScript-heavy sites (headless-browser rendering) and markdown:true for clean LLM-ready markdown instead of raw HTML. BYOK — _apiKey is your Decodo Web Scraping API "username:password" credentials. Example: decodo_scrape({ url: "https://example.com", render_js: true, _apiKey: "user:pass" })

url.description: The absolute URL of the page to scrape, e.g. "https://example.com/products"

render_js.description: Render the page in a headless browser (executes JavaScript) before returning content. Default false (faster raw fetch of static pages).

geo.description: Proxy exit location as a location name, e.g. "United States", "Germany", "Japan". Default: randomized.

markdown.description: Return the page as clean markdown instead of raw HTML (ideal for feeding an LLM). Default false.

_apiKey.description: Decodo Web Scraping API credentials as "username:password" (from the dashboard at https://dashboard.decodo.com — free plan available).

name: decodo_google_search
description: Google search results scraping via Decodo (formerly Smartproxy) — runs a Google search through rotating proxies and returns structured organic results (position, title, url, snippet) plus related searches when parsing succeeds. BYOK — _apiKey is your Decodo Web Scraping API "username:password" credentials. Example: decodo_google_search({ query: "best running shoes 2026", geo: "United States", _apiKey: "user:pass" })

query.description: The Google search query, e.g. "best running shoes 2026"

geo.description: Location name to geotarget the search, e.g. "United States", "United Kingdom". Optional.

locale.description: Language code for the Google interface, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE". Optional.

page_count.description: Number of result pages to retrieve (1-10). Default 1.

_apiKey.description: Decodo Web Scraping API credentials as "username:password" (from https://dashboard.decodo.com).

name: decodo_amazon_product
description: Get structured Amazon product data via Decodo (formerly Smartproxy) — title, pricing, rating, reviews, images, availability — parsed into JSON. Pass either a full Amazon product URL or an ASIN. BYOK — _apiKey is your Decodo Web Scraping API "username:password" credentials. Example: decodo_amazon_product({ asin: "B09H74FXNW", _apiKey: "user:pass" })

url.description: Full Amazon product page URL, e.g. "https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09H74FXNW". Provide this or `asin`.

asin.description: Amazon ASIN (product identifier), e.g. "B09H74FXNW". Used to build the product URL when `url` is omitted.

domain.description: Amazon marketplace domain used with `asin`, e.g. "com" (default), "co.uk", "de".

geo.description: Proxy exit location as a location name, e.g. "United States". Optional.

_apiKey.description: Decodo Web Scraping API credentials as "username:password" (from https://dashboard.decodo.com).
